papers.title: A Study of Bluetooth Access Control Based on NFT Soft Pairing
papers.summary: This paper proposes a Non-Fungible Token (NFT) soft pairing framework for Bluetooth service access control. Unlike conventional Bluetooth systems where pairing implicitly grants persistent service access, the proposed approach decouples native Bluetooth pairing from authorization without modifying the underlying protocol stack. The framework introduces a three-layer architecture consisting of a Bluetooth layer for connectivity, a blockchain layer for trusted execution and on-chain state verification, and an application layer where NFT soft pairing defines the authorization logic. In this design, Non-Fungible Bluetooth Tokens (NFBTs) represent user-side access credentials, while Non-Fungible Device Tokens (NFDTs) represent device identities. Their bidirectional on-chain binding forms a revocable and verifiable NFT soft pairing relationship. During access, users prove ownership of valid NFBTs through challenge-response signatures, and devices verify the corresponding on-chain state before granting service access. A prototype implemented with MetaMask and Ethereum demonstrates secure authentication, dynamic revocation, acceptable latency, and gas-efficient credential issuance based on ERC1155.

ai.tldr: 提出一种基于NFT软配对的蓝牙服务访问控制框架，将蓝牙配对与授权解耦，通过区块链上的NFT绑定实现可撤销、可验证的访问控制。
ai.motivation: 传统蓝牙配对隐式授予持久服务访问权限，缺乏细粒度、可撤销的授权机制，难以适应动态安全需求。
ai.method: 设计三层架构：蓝牙层负责连接，区块链层负责可信执行和状态验证，应用层通过NFT软配对定义授权逻辑。用户持有NFBT作为凭证，设备持有NFDT作为身份，双向链上绑定形成软配对关系。访问时通过挑战-响应签名证明所有权，设备验证链上状态后授予服务。
ai.result: 基于MetaMask和以太坊的原型验证了安全认证、动态撤销、可接受延迟和基于ERC1155的gas高效凭证发行。
ai.help_to_user: 为物联网设备提供一种无需修改蓝牙协议栈即可实现灵活、可撤销的访问控制方案，适用于需要动态授权管理的场景。

idea_spark.idea: 将NFT软配对与去中心化身份（DID）结合，实现更细粒度的权限管理，或引入时间限制和条件授权。
idea_spark.risk: 依赖区块链网络，可能面临交易延迟和成本问题；NFT私钥管理不当可能导致凭证丢失或被盗。
idea_spark.inspiration: 启发将区块链技术应用于传统设备认证，实现去中心化、可审计的访问控制，同时保持对现有协议的兼容性。

zh.tldr: 提出一种基于NFT软配对的蓝牙服务访问控制框架，将蓝牙配对与授权解耦，通过区块链上的NFT绑定实现可撤销、可验证的访问控制。
zh.motivation: 传统蓝牙配对隐式授予持久服务访问权限，缺乏细粒度、可撤销的授权机制，难以适应动态安全需求。
zh.method: 设计三层架构：蓝牙层负责连接，区块链层负责可信执行和状态验证，应用层通过NFT软配对定义授权逻辑。用户持有NFBT作为凭证，设备持有NFDT作为身份，双向链上绑定形成软配对关系。访问时通过挑战-响应签名证明所有权，设备验证链上状态后授予服务。
zh.result: 基于MetaMask和以太坊的原型验证了安全认证、动态撤销、可接受延迟和基于ERC1155的gas高效凭证发行。
zh.help_to_user: 为物联网设备提供一种无需修改蓝牙协议栈即可实现灵活、可撤销的访问控制方案，适用于需要动态授权管理的场景。

en.tldr: Proposes an NFT soft pairing framework for Bluetooth service access control, decoupling pairing from authorization via blockchain-based NFT binding, enabling revocable and verifiable access.
en.motivation: Conventional Bluetooth pairing implicitly grants persistent service access, lacking fine-grained and revocable authorization mechanisms for dynamic security needs.
en.method: A three-layer architecture: Bluetooth layer for connectivity, blockchain layer for trusted execution and on-chain state verification, and application layer where NFT soft pairing defines authorization logic. Users hold NFBTs as credentials, devices hold NFDTs as identities, and bidirectional on-chain binding forms soft pairing. Access requires challenge-response signature proof and on-chain state verification.
en.result: A prototype with MetaMask and Ethereum demonstrates secure authentication, dynamic revocation, acceptable latency, and gas-efficient credential issuance based on ERC1155.
en.help_to_user: Provides a flexible, revocable access control solution for IoT devices without modifying the Bluetooth protocol stack, suitable for dynamic authorization management.

idea_spark.idea: Combine NFT soft pairing with decentralized identity (DID) for finer-grained permissions, or introduce time-limited and conditional authorization.
idea_spark.risk: Dependence on blockchain may incur transaction latency and costs; improper management of NFT private keys could lead to credential loss or theft.
idea_spark.inspiration: Inspires applying blockchain to traditional device authentication for decentralized, auditable access control while maintaining compatibility with existing protocols.
